subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the four guard assertions are repaired and exact-head checks pass, should the privileged action revisions be approved as one grouped dependency batch?
rationale: The consistency repair is mechanical, but authorizing new third-party executable revisions in token-bearing and security-scanning workflows requires the designated security owner.

options.title: Repair and approve the batch
options.body: Update all four assertions, verify exact-head workflow checks, and approve the grouped revisions after security-owner review.

options.title: Split privileged actions
options.body: Move CodeQL, token-minting, Docker credential, and Codex action updates into a separate narrowly reviewed PR.

recommendation.title: Repair and approve the batch
recommendation.body: Update all four assertions, verify exact-head workflow checks, and approve the grouped revisions after security-owner review.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS explicitly assigns several central changed security workflows to this team.
